name: Broadcom (AVGO)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. Broadcom guides AI revenue to double twice, yet at $291.53 the price fits only about 61% of the fiscal 2028 plan; Base $342.39, buy zone $196.88.
llms: Broadcom Inc. (AVGO) designs custom AI accelerators and networking chips for Google, Anthropic, OpenAI and Meta, other semiconductors, and VMware infrastructure software. Valued with a ten-year free cash flow model after stock-based pay and a forward EV/EBIT cross-check on fiscal 2028. Management guides AI revenue of about $115 billion in fiscal 2027 and $230 billion in fiscal 2028; the price implies about $141 billion in fiscal 2028. Bear $171.30, Base $342.39, Bull $529.44. Verdict Hold at $291.53 (November 5, 2026 close), maximum buy price $196.88.
